That's the job of a good agency: take a platform that can do almost anything and turn it into the few things your business actually needs.

body.summary:
HighLevel wants to be a $10 billion business. $9 billion of that is meant to go to its customers.

Shaun Clark, co-founder and CEO of HighLevel, says they benchmark it internally: if customers aren't making 10x, 100x, 1,000x more than they pay, there's a problem.

And his take on where agencies fit: no matter how cheap software gets, people don't want tools. They want outcomes. That's why agencies will always have a place.
